comments.value: Sir, this is a feedback site, not a place for rants.

details:
I had fun playing vrc.

I don't feel fun at the moment.

30 friends online.

This is because more than 20 people are orange private.

In the past, everyone could join.

A year later, there are a lot of private users now.

You should check how many users are in private state.

I don't think it's a problem if it's private for a while.

You lose interest by watching private users all year round.

I respect protecting your privacy,

It should not be abused.

He comes to me only when he wants to.

I'm keeping the orange private so that others can't come.

The number of users has increased too much.

What do you feel when you see 50 friends online?

50 friends logged in, 40 in private,

How does it feel?

He ignores me when I send him a message.

Users who refuse to come to themselves and come only when they need them,

It's stretched like crazy.

This game is a communication game.

Users who access while disconnecting communication have a problem.

I want to convert this personal private function to a fee.

If it's not for a fee, I want it to be unavailable for more than one hour out of 24 hours.

There is a private world.

Whatever you do with your friend there, the space is a private space.

There's a private world.  

I think account private can be deleted.

When I accessed vrc,

When I checked my friend list,

I hope my friends are no longer in a private state.

This game is a communication game.

It's not a game to deny communication.

If you applied for a friend, you should hang out with him.

Why do they keep living in private?

I also asked other friends.

It is said that it is not fun to see friends staying private.

50 people logged in. 40 people are in private.

Thirty of them are private all year round.

Do you play games to be private?

Is this a private game? 

What is private?

For the future of vrc.

Personal private functionality is a function that needs to be gone.

There's a private world. 

If you want to do something private, you have to do it in the private world.

I hope you don't go around the world in a private state.
title: Remove Private State.request
